requirements.requirement: The system must return a list of clinical trials from evaluate_care_facade where each trial includes a composite_score field.
The system must include a measure_breakdown object per trial containing all contributing measures used in scoring.
The system must ensure the composite_score value is numeric and within the normalized range defined by the scoring schema.
The system must preserve all original clinical trial fields from clinical_trials_service alongside scoring fields in the response.
The system must invoke the clinical trial scoring logic for every trial returned by the facade.
The system must return trials sorted in descending order by composite_score by default.
The system must include a version or schema identifier for the scoring model in the response payload.
The system must ensure that measure_breakdown contains at least three measures per trial as defined by the scoring schema.
The system must return consistent composite_score values for identical input data across repeated calls (determinism).
The system must expose scoring results in a JSON-serializable structure compatible with downstream UI consumption.
The system must return an empty list when no clinical trials are found, without throwing an error.
The system must handle missing or incomplete measure inputs by still returning a composite_score using fallback normalization rules.
The system must return a structured error response when the scoring logic dependency fails or is unavailable.
The system must not omit trials from the response solely due to scoring failures and instead include them with a null or flagged composite_score.
